Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activity rows against human single-protein target CHEMBL1741186 (Nuclear receptor ROR-gamma). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, target type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax ID 9606, standard type IC50, exact standard relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
